## Funding allocation

| Work package | Purpose | Deliverable | Acceptance criterion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Validation | OOS + regression | validation environment | reproducible clean runs |
| Data | reliable evidence | versioned snapshots | provenance + replay |
| Compute | experiments | batch evaluation | artifact-backed results |
| AI research | bounded model evaluation | comparison harness | no opaque decision authority |
| Operations | deployment | observability + audit | operational validation |
| Outcome evaluation | decision-to-realization linkage | learning/calibration loop | feedback recorded per experiment |

## Rationale

AurumAI already contains substantial intelligence infrastructure. The remaining bottleneck is not feature count; it is demonstrating empirical predictive value, evidence integrity, reproducibility, and operational reliability.

## Claims boundary

Do not claim profitability, alpha, live performance, or institutional readiness without a current reproducible artifact.

Live execution remains downstream of OOS validation, historical production validation, paper trading, risk validation, and institutional release approval.
